headline: Itaú Unibanco Q3 Profit Reaches Record R$ 12.6 Billion on Credit Growth
summary: Itaú Unibanco reported a record third-quarter net profit of R$ 12.6 billion, marking its 12th consecutive quarterly increase driven by credit growth, though profitability and service revenue softened.
why: Itaú Unibanco is Latin America's largest private bank, making its earnings a primary indicator of banking sector health, consumer credit demand, and loan portfolio quality.

impacts.name: Itau Unibanco Holding SA
impacts.why: Net profit reached a record R$ 12.6 billion, marking the 12th straight quarterly rise.
